Card Q&A.q: Does this card's inherited effect activate even if your opponent didn't have a Digimon in play for their entire turn?
Does this card's inherited effect activate if you activate effects to prevent all of your opponent's Digimon from attacking?

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't. They attacked this turn, so the effect doesn't apply.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's inherited effect activate if your opponent's Digimon were all deleted in battle after attacking?

Inherited Effect: [End of Opponent's Turn] If your opponent didn't attack with a Digimon this turn, trigger ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
